reason: This is an executor-side join optimization touching core join machinery (`join.go`, `joiner.go`, hash table, index lookup hash join, and CTE paths) for left outer semi/anti-semi joins. Those operators are correctness-sensitive and can easily introduce wrong-result bugs, especially around null semantics, unmatched-row handling, and algorithm-specific paths. The change is central enough and broad enough within executor internals to justify a focused Blocker/High deep review.
